title: When the conversation breaks
transcript:
Customer: My internet has been dropping all morning.
Agent: That's not our problem. Restart the router.
Customer: I already restarted it three times.
Agent: Then I don't know what you expect me to do.
Customer: I want to speak with someone else.

key_points: No troubleshooting beyond a previously attempted restart; customer requested another agent.
expected.resolution_details: No troubleshooting beyond a previously attempted restart; customer requested another agent.
